data.key: Sorcerer Bonus Spell L6 ~ Circle of Death
data.name: Circle of Death
data.description: Circle of death snuffs out the life force of living creatures, killing them instantly. The spell slays 1d4 HD worth of living creatures per caster level [maximum 20d4]. Creatures with the fewest HD are affected first; among creatures with equal HD, those who are closest to the burst's point of origin are affected first. No creature of 9 or more HD can be affected, and HD that are not sufficient to affect a creature are wasted.|PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell
